description: Phase 1 attachment socket contract. Blender preserves these names through export and UE5 binds props by socket name.
rules: Socket names are frozen after Phase 1.
Every exported bone uses the mixamorig: namespace; centaur equine extensions also use mixamorig:Horse* names.
Knights and rooks mount tower shields on Socket_Weapon_L.
King hip sword is mounted at Socket_Sword_Hip.
Rook castle staff uses Socket_CastleStaff and must preserve the complete castle silhouette.

sockets.name: Socket_Weapon_R
sockets.purpose: Royal/crook staff, knight sword, pawn spear, or ordinary primary prop

sockets.name: Socket_CastleStaff
sockets.purpose: Massive castle staff: battlements, side turrets, gate

sockets.name: Socket_Helm
sockets.purpose: Crown, mitre, horse-head helm or kettle helm
